title: Conversion of individual membership into corporate membership
text: Conversion of individual membership into corporate membership Dec 11, 1997| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMD/POLICY/CIR-34/97 December 11, 1997 To, Presidents/Executive Directors/Managing Directors of All Stock Exchanges. Dear Sir, Sub : Conversion of individual membership into corporate membership We have been receiving requests from stock exchanges seeking clarification regarding trading rights of the members who are corporatising their individual membership, pending SEBI Registration. In the above context, the following may please be noted : In case of corporatisation of individual membership, the individual member may trade in his individual name pending registration of the corporate member by SEBI. In case the corporate member acquires the membership through purchase of membership card of an individual member, the corporate member shall not be entitled to trade because of the provisions of Section 12 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992, till registration is granted to the corporate member by SEBI. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, M. D. PATEL EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR
